checks.title: Error handling
items: Ignored `err` (`_ =` or missing check) on I/O, network, or parsing calls.
`err` shadowed inside an `if`/`for` block so the outer variable stays nil.
Wrapping that loses the original (`fmt.Errorf` without `%w`) where callers need `errors.Is`.

checks.title: Concurrency
items: Goroutines started without a way to stop them (no `context.Context` or done channel).
`defer` inside a loop that accumulates until the function returns.
Loop variables captured by a goroutine or closure (pre-1.22 semantics).

checks.title: Resources and boundaries
items: Unbounded slice growth from external input; missing limits on request bodies.

examples.note: response body always closed, error returned
closed only on the happy path: leaks on error
